# PLAN — iteration 3

## Current state assessment

The verified incumbent is still timing-infeasible at WNS −2.766 ns, though hold is positive at 0.168 ns; iterations 1 and 2 were accepted as timing progress, not closure. The generation seed already has a symmetric-coefficient path and registered `y_out`. The advisor’s trial also remained at −2.766 ns and reported a path from an output replica register to the output port, so output-register replication did not close timing.

## Hypothesis

Applying the 7-series `IOB` property to the existing `y_out` register may reduce its register-to-port delay and improve setup slack without adding state or changing observable cycles.

## Instruction for generator

Keep the FIR arithmetic, pipeline registers, reset behavior, and `y_out` register assignment unchanged; add the Xilinx `IOB = "TRUE"` synthesis attribute to the existing `y_out` output register so Vivado can place it in an I/O block. Preserve `// @latency 1` and verify that the port remains registered with identical reset and cycle behavior. Run the fixed verification and routed flow, and promote only if all gates pass and the measured timing comparison qualifies under the objective.
